name: warpforge-demo
description: Motion-graphic demo of the WarpForge compiler, built with Remotion

scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render WarpForgeDemo out/warpforge-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.render:gif: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render WarpForgeTeaser out/teaser.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --muted && node scripts/make-gif.mjs
scripts.still: npm run prepare-assets && remotion still WarpForgeDemo
scripts.prepare-assets: npm run sync && npm run audio
